ns2:course.label: Intermediate Portuguese
ns2:course.description: Continued development of reading, writing and conversational skills. Completion of this course fulfills the third-semester level of Portuguese language instruction. Followed by a 200- or 300-level course in Portuguese, this course fulfills the fourth-semester level of Portuguese language instruction. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours. Prerequisite: PORT 400 or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours. Prerequisite: PORT 400 or consent of instructor.
